about: Live regression cases for the powerquery skill. Every case pins one documented behaviour. Run with tools/pq_live_regression.py. Queries are portable: they use only SentinelOne EDR fields and common Windows binary names, never tenant-specific values.
requires: A tenant ingesting SentinelOne EDR telemetry from Windows endpoints (Process Creation, File Creation, File Modification, DNS Resolved, IP Connect). Cases with "fixtures" need the listed datatables; the runner writes them before the run and deletes them afterwards.

cases.query: event.type='Process Creation' src.process.name in (event.type='Process Creation' src.process.name='svchost.exe' | group 1 by src.process.name) | group n=count()

expect.with: event.type='Process Creation' src.process.name='svchost.exe' | group n=count()

cases.query: event.type in ('Process Creation','File Creation') src.process.name in ('svchost.exe','explorer.exe') !(event.type in (event.type in ('Process Creation','File Creation') ((event.type='Process Creation' src.process.name='svchost.exe') or (event.type='File Creation' src.process.name='explorer.exe')) | group 1 by event.type)) !(src.process.name in (event.type in ('Process Creation','File Creation') ((event.type='Process Creation' src.process.name='svchost.exe') or (event.type='File Creation' src.process.name='explorer.exe')) | group 1 by src.process.name)) | group n=count() by event.type, src.process.name

expect.with: event.type in ('Process Creation','File Creation') src.process.name in ('svchost.exe','explorer.exe') !((event.type='Process Creation' && src.process.name='svchost.exe') || (event.type='File Creation' && src.process.name='explorer.exe')) | group n=count() by event.type, src.process.name
